data.body:
The description cap is now operator-configurable: verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000), landed as Gerrit change 1697 / ticket 594b-3118-208c-4766 (unsinful-cliffy-arcticseal).

Relevant to this ticket's deferred close, which was blocked at 8,001 characters against the 8,000 cap — one character over. Two ways forward for a successor: trim a single character from the description (the cheapest fix), or the operator raises verify.max_ticket_description_chars in the project config, which both the plan-review guard and the completion precheck read.

Note also that create/edit now warn at SAVE time when a description goes over the configured cap while the plan-review claim gate is on (CLI stderr, library logger, MCP description_warning result field), so a future 8,001-char description is reported the moment it is written rather than at review time.
